nom: Nip + Fab Glycolic Fix Night Pads Extreme (60 Count)

segments.oily: One reviewer whose daughter has very oily skin, using the pads on her dermatologist's recommendation to help control oil, reports her skin ended up moisturized rather than oily, alongside faded acne scarring.
segments.dry: One reviewer with acne-prone, dry, dull skin reports her breakouts stopped lingering as long and her complexion became brighter and healthier after switching to these pads from a harsher salicylic-only product.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including some who call it extremely or severely sensitive, report no burning, redness, or irritation even with regular use; one reviewer very sensitive to fragrance, however, reacted with itchy skin after finding the pads contain a perfume despite being marketed unscented.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin reports no irritation beyond a slight tingling sensation, alongside a plumper, more youthful-looking complexion.
segments.mature: Reviewers around or over 40 report fewer visible fine lines and a more youthful-looking complexion with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers around or over 40 report fewer visible fine lines and a more youthful appearance with continued use, including one whose partner describes her skin as looking younger than her age after long-term use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the pads do not leave skin feeling dry or stripped, describing it as more moisturized and refreshed after use.
concerns.redness: A number of reviewers report significant burning, stinging, or sunburn-like redness lasting hours after a single use, including some whose reaction appeared suddenly after months of prior trouble-free use; several other reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation at all, and one describes only mild redness that calms down after use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of acne scars, dark spots, sun spots, or discoloration patches with regular use, sometimes within one to two weeks; one long-time user, however, says the lightening was only partial and her dark spots began reappearing when she used the pads less frequently.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin with fewer active breakouts, blackheads, and cystic pimples after weeks to months of regular use, including some who say it worked after other acne products had failed; one reviewer's teenage son, however, had a severe burning reaction when using it on acne scars, underscoring the need to patch-test first.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer whose daughter has very oily skin reports the pads helped control excess oil on a dermatologist's recommendation, leaving skin moisturized without looking oily.

aspects.libelle: Marketed as unscented but contains fragrance
Lid keeps pads from drying out
Mild citrus scent that fades quickly

extraits.texte: My daughter has been suffering from cystic acne for years, and while her acne had gotten under control she still had some scars and discoloration. She also has very oily skin. Her dermatologist recommended buying glycolic acid pads to control the oil as well as help fade the scars. About 2 months after using it and almost all her acne scars are gone! And her skin is moisturized but not oily. Her face is the smoothest and clearest it has been in a long time and we’re both happy with the results.

I have always had horrible skin. It is very acne prone, dry, dull, peeling in spots, and when I wake up in the morning you can literally see all of the disgustingness clogging the pores of my face. I recently stopped taking hormonal birth control and my skin has gotten ten times worse. Typically I use a benzoyl peroxide cleaner with a rotating brush. That works wonders but since my skin is now getting worse even that is having a hard time keeping up. I purchased some salicylic acid pads in hopes that the benzoyl peroxide would kill any bacteria and the salicylic acid would help exfoliate the dead skin cells but they have never really worked well for me and this time was no exception. They help to exfoliate, but they always leave my skin dry, tight and shiny. I decided I needed to try something different so I purchased these glycolic pads. I wasn't sure what to expect when I bought them so I was really pleasantly surprised when they worked so well. These pads contain both glycolic acid as well as salicylic acid and the combination has really made a difference in my skin. I am noticing my pimples don't last as long, my face is brighter and overall my skin looks much healthier. The pads have a citrus smell to them. The pads themselves are not as abrasive as a typical salicylic acid pad which after some research I have learned is a good thing. extraits.titre: Noticeable difference in my skin.....I LOVE! :)
extraits.texte: I love these glycolic extreme pads so much. They really do wonders for my skin. I have extremely sensitive skin and I've noticed no irritation from using these. I use the pads every other night and have had no redness or irritation. I have noticed a significant change in my skin though. I'm seeing a lot less acne and I also think my blackheads have decreased around my nose a lot since using these. Also, I have millia under my eyes (tiny little white bumps under the skin that stick around for foreeeever it seems) and I've even started noticing a difference in those as well. It looks like they are decreasing in size and slowly getting flatter and flatter. Seriously recommend this for anyone with skin issues they'd like to fix, even those with severely sensitive skin like myself.

extraits.titre: Great product! Make sure to wear sunscreen!!
extraits.texte: Can't explain how happy I am to find these! I absolutely loved the St. Ives exfoliating pads, but was super bummed when they discontinued them a few years ago. Was recently on a skincare forum and someone brought up how much they missed using the St. Ives pads, too, when another user suggested these. So glad they did! I actually like these more than the other one and am already seeing nice results after just a short use. They really plumped my face up and I look a few yrs younger, already, & my husband commented on how nice my skin is glowing! I only use it 2x a week in the pm right now, I cleanse, tone, then just swipe the product on, then moisturize. I'm definitely going to stock up on these to make sure I always have some on hand! I really like how it's AHA/BHA in one pad. I have sensitive combo skin & do just fine with these, just a very slight tingling afterwards. The scent is very citrusy but I don't mind it, at all, and the smell goes away pretty fast. I always suggest to others to wear sunscreen daily, but definitely MAKE SURE to wear sunscreen while using this product! This product will definitely make you more sensitive to the sun, so you'll need a good sunscreen to go along with it.

extraits.titre: Caution! if you have sensitive skin!!
extraits.texte: Bought this for my keratosis pilaris and within 5 minutes my skin turned bright red (it doesn’t hurt but it does feel pretty warm to the touch) If you want to try this product I highly recommend spot testing on a small area before rubbing it all over both of your arms like I did!

Not for me... IVE NEVER AND I MEAN NEVER had a reaction to anything but after I applied one of these pads it made my whole face red like a sunburn!! Not using again. I don’t have sensitive skin and have never been through this. Shocking ☹️ I felt fine at first and smelled great but then I felt hot and looked in the mirror to see my face burned like a day at the River with no sunblock

extraits.titre: The best wipes for fine lines and wrinkles.
extraits.texte: My fiancé has been using glycolic acid lotion and wipes since she was very young and it has helped a lot preventing wrinkles and lines. She loves those wipes and uses them a lot. She is now 51 and this is how she looks. Everyone tells her she looks younger than her age and I agree. She also wears a moisturizer with sunscreen every morning before going outside.
